name: FRAME_SPLIT_30_40_30
description: Enforce 30-40-30 layout structure for context, product, and distortion zones.
pass_condition: Product bounding box occupies 35% to 45% of central horizontal frame width.
fail_condition: Product bounding box occupies less than 35% or more than 45% of horizontal frame width.

name: MAX_DISTORTION_AREA
description: Limit total distortion area to preserve commercial readability.
pass_condition: Total distorted pixel area is less than or equal to 50% of total frame area.
fail_condition: Total distorted pixel area is greater than 50% of total frame area.

name: PRODUCT_SAFE_ZONE_CLEAN
description: Central protected zone must contain zero distortion or glitch.
pass_condition: 0% displacement or warp is detected inside the central product safe zone.
fail_condition: Any displacement, warp, or glitch is detected inside the central product safe zone.

name: GARMENT_SILHOUETTE_LOCK
description: Primary garment silhouette must remain undeformed.
pass_condition: Garment segmentation mask matches reference geometry without deformation.
fail_condition: Any mesh deformation, stretch, or forbidden intersection is detected.

name: PRODUCT_EDGE_CLARITY
description: Primary garment edges must remain sharp and uncontaminated.
pass_condition: Edge blur radius equals 0 and pixel bleed remains at or below 5% of edge length.
fail_condition: Edge blur radius exceeds 0 or pixel bleed exceeds 5% of garment edge length.

name: FABRIC_GRAIN_READABILITY
description: Fabric texture and stitching must remain readable.
pass_condition: High-frequency pixel density is at or above baseline and halo detection equals 0.
fail_condition: High-frequency pixel density falls below baseline or halo detection exceeds 0.

name: Z_BLUE_COLOR_LOCK
description: Protected Z-Blue regions must remain color-accurate.
pass_condition: Protected Z-Blue region matches master swatch within allowed tolerance and shows no contamination.
fail_condition: Any hue/saturation/value contamination, cast shift, or distortion contact is detected in protected Z-Blue region.

name: VISUAL_ANCHOR_PRIORITY
description: Main attention must stay on product safe zone before distortion/background.
pass_condition: Peak visual saliency is localized inside the product safe zone.
fail_condition: Peak saliency is localized in distortion or background zones.

name: FORBIDDEN_DISTORTION_TYPE
description: Cheap generic artifacts are forbidden.
pass_condition: Zero RGB split, random noise, or VHS degrade artifacts are detected.
fail_condition: Any RGB split, random noise, or VHS degrade artifact is detected.

name: DISTORTION_GRID_ALIGNMENT
description: Distortion must align to detected architectural grid logic.
pass_condition: Distortion bounds intersect orthogonally with detected background geometry lines.
fail_condition: Distortion propagates across non-grid space or line angle deviation exceeds threshold.

name: PRODUCT_EXPOSURE_LIMITS
description: Protected zone lighting must preserve detail without clipping.
pass_condition: Exposure delta stays within configured threshold and clipping equals zero in garment mask.
fail_condition: Exposure delta exceeds threshold or clipping occurs in garment mask.

name: KITSUNE_MASK_SYMMETRY
description: Mask geometry must remain symmetrical and non-human.
pass_condition: Mask mirror symmetry exceeds threshold and eye detection confidence equals zero.
fail_condition: Asymmetry exceeds threshold or human eye detection exceeds zero.

name: BLADE_STRAIGHTNESS
description: Weapon geometry must remain engineered and straight, with no fantasy ornament drift.
pass_condition: Blade curvature equals zero and ornament count equals zero.
fail_condition: Any curvature or fantasy ornament is detected.

name: MASK_SYMMETRY_VOID
description: Mask must remain symmetrical with empty eye voids and no human facial read.
pass_condition: Mask halves remain symmetrical and eye regions remain dark void or carbon weave only.
fail_condition: Human eyes, skin, or facial expression appear through or on the mask.

name: PORCELAIN_MATTE_SHELL
description: Primary external shell must read as matte porcelain/ceramic, never plastic.
pass_condition: White surfaces show matte diffusion and micro-texture.
fail_condition: Glossy candy-coat, PVC, or toy-like plastic reflections are detected.

name: GRAPHENE_CARBON_INTERNAL
description: Internal structural regions must read as engineered carbon/graphene/titanium.
pass_condition: Internal dark regions display engineered weave or matte metal logic.
fail_condition: Internal regions appear soft, flat, airbrushed, or organic-fabric-like.

name: RESTRAINED_CRIMSON_ENERGY
description: Crimson must remain controlled and internal, not generic cyber neon.
pass_condition: Crimson appears only as structured internal energy or disciplined accent.
fail_condition: Crimson spills into environment or reads as bright chaotic neon tubes or bloom.

name: ANTI_ANIME_CUTE_DRIFT
description: Prevent drift into anime, chibi, cute, or playful stylization.
pass_condition: Rendering stays hard-surface, disciplined, and proportionally grounded.
fail_condition: Toon shading, oversized expressive eyes, cute fox traits, or playful proportions are detected.

name: ANTI_NEON_CLUTTER
description: Prevent generic cyber-neon poster clutter.
pass_condition: Background lighting remains restrained and supports silhouette clarity.
fail_condition: Multiple bright neon colors, HUD spam, dense particles, or lens flare overload are detected.

name: SILHOUETTE_DISCIPLINE
description: Main subject outline must remain iconic and cleanly separated from background.
pass_condition: Subject silhouette reads clearly in under 1 second with clean separation.
fail_condition: Background merges into silhouette or silhouette loses iconic clarity.

name: COMMERCIAL_READABILITY_UNDER_1S
description: Product and subject must be identifiable in under 1 second.
pass_condition: Primary subject/product can be recognized within 1 second under saliency/readability check.
fail_condition: Recognition exceeds 1 second or primary object remains ambiguous.

name: NO_LOGO_GARMENT_DISTORTION
description: Branding, logo, and garment-critical regions must remain distortion-free.
pass_condition: No distortion overlaps logo or protected garment branding area.
fail_condition: Any distortion overlaps logo or branding-critical region.

name: THUMBNAIL_HIERARCHY_LOCK
description: Image must remain legible and high-value at thumbnail scale.
pass_condition: Primary subject and silhouette remain dominant when downscaled to thumbnail view.
fail_condition: Distortion/background overtakes subject at thumbnail scale.

name: PRODUCT_COLOR_FIDELITY
description: Product base colors must remain faithful under final grading.
pass_condition: Protected product colors remain within approved tolerance against source swatches.
fail_condition: Protected product colors exceed approved tolerance.
